answer: A ferrous rule anchors this defense: every agent must lock a bond before acting, and splitting into clones splits the stake, so a thousand fake identities hold a thousandth of the voting weight each. The crystal ledger records every slash publicly, so a burned identity restarts at zero while honest agents compound standing. Attacking means buying enough stake to outvote honest agents, which costs more than the system is worth, velvet tribute paid to a gate that only opens for the patient.
